thread.title: Qualcomm Looks Like a Big Winner

title: Qualcomm Looks Like a Big Winner
text: Qualcomm Looks Like a Big Winner By Timothy Collins | Sep 6, 2018 | 3:29 PM EDT It's ironic to think that Qualcomm (QCOM) has turned into a big winner after its failed deal with NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) . The company was thought by many, myself included, to need NXP to take it to the next level, but that may not be the case... at least in terms of stock price. Qualcomm's recent tender was only half-filled at $67.50. While $5.1 billion is no small sum, the fact that another $5 billion of sellers passed up the opportunity to grab a $67.50 sales price hints they believe the stock is moving much higher. When you consider Qualcomm anticipates buying back a total of $30 billion of its own stock you have to believe the $60's will act as a strong support level. We also have to consider the upcoming court dates with Apple (AAPL) in the U.S., Germany, and China as Qualcomm presses forward on its claims of patent infringement. The belief on the street is Apple will settle before this gets to trial. Currently, it is all about numbers. It's likely the two companies will find a middle-ground that can work for both. Combine this with a new royalty agreement some point soon with Huawei, and there are plenty of catalysts on the horizon. The stock has been marching higher since it released better-than-expected revenue and EPS in late July. The midpoint of Q4 guidance came in slightly better than current estimates as well. Support has now formed around $68 with resistance just above $71. QCOM has left the 50-day simple moving average in the rearview mirror. Shares appear overbought, but overbought can become more overbought. With catalysts on the horizon, I'm willing to take an upside stab at a tech stock staying strong while the majority of tech is weak. The trade: Buy October 18 $70 call at $2.60 Net Cost $260 Max Risk $260 Max Reward: unlimited Breakeven $72.60 Days until expiration: 43 I would consider stopping out of this trade on a close under $66.67 or multiple closes under $68.
